open_issues: Outcome check (criterion 7) is not verified and is not claimed. It must be checked on the next landing's pull request: one CI run per commit, and the landing time. D125 records this as a follow-up.

The plan assumes the host's default branch is named `main`. This was not checked against the host's settings. If the default branch has another name, `branches: [main]` would stop default-branch pushes from running CI and saving the shared caches, and the cache save conditions (which use github.event.repository.default_branch) would no longer match.

Pushes to non-main branches, including athena/records, no longer start CI. This is recorded in D125 and the CHANGELOG as intended. Records are not code, but any tooling that expects a push run on athena/records would need a look.
The full `cargo test --locked` suite was not run (targeted tests and clippy only), as the brief asks for the suite to be run at most once. Athena runs it on the candidate.
mistakes: I read the request's '(two push runs) ran the full 16 minutes' as each run taking 16 minutes. The request could also mean 16 minutes in total. The decision and CHANGELOG use 'each'; this should be confirmed against the PR #185 run records.
learnings: crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs `early_run_wait` / `wait_for_early_run` look up only the check run named EARLY_RUN_JOB ('fmt, clippy, tests') on the early commit; they do not filter by workflow event, so removing push runs does not change what land waits for.
docs/decisions.md ends at D124. The D122 test pins the first 230046 bytes; appending D125 kept that pin valid (the decisions test passed).
